criteria.text: The participant is chemotherapy-naive and is planned to receive AC or cisplatin-based chemotherapy ≥70 mg/m² on Day 1 of each cycle, with no multiple administrations during the CINV observation period (Day 2 to Day 5 of each cycle).

source.text: Chemotherapy-naive participants, planned to receive AC or cisplatin-based chemotherapy greater than or equal to (≥)70 milligrams per square meter (mg/m²), on Day 1 of each cycle, with no multiple administrations during the CINV observation period, from Day 2 to Day 5 of each cycle.

criteria.text: The participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 2.

source.text: Have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 2.

criteria.text: The participant has symptomatic or untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastases.

source.text: Have symptomatic or untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastases.

criteria.text: The participant has an established diagnosis of uncontrolled diabetes mellitus.

source.text: Have an established diagnosis of uncontrolled diabetes mellitus.

criteria.text: The participant has a history of, or current evidence of, a clinically significant cardiac condition or QT/QTcF-related conditions.

source.text: Have a history of, or current evidence of, a clinically significant cardiac condition or QT/QTcF-related conditions.

criteria.text: The participant has another etiology for nausea and vomiting, or receives medications with known or potential antiemetic activity.

source.text: Have another etiology for nausea and vomiting, or receives medications with know or potential antiemetic activity

criteria.text: The participant has signs, symptoms, or a history of thyroid tumors.

source.text: Signs, symptoms or history of thyroid tumors

criteria.text: The participant receives treatment with a gastric inhibitory polypeptide (GIP) or glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist within 4 weeks prior to chemotherapy.

source.text: Receives treatment with a gastric inhibitory polypetide (GIP) or glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist within 4 weeks prior to chemotherapy.

criteria.text: The participant has participated in a clinical study involving study intervention within 30 days of Cycle 1 Day 1 (C1D1), or within 3 months or 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) of C1D1 if the previous study intervention has a long half-life.

source.text: Have participated in a clinical study involving study intervention within 30 days of Cycle 1 Day 1 (C1D1). If the previous study intervention has a long half-life, within 3 months or 5 halflives, whichever is longer, of C1D1.

criteria.text: The participant is pregnant, breastfeeding, or intends to become pregnant during the study or within 30 days of the last dose of study intervention.

source.text: Are pregnant, breastfeeding, or intend to become pregnant during the study or within 30 days of the last dose of study intervention.
